metadata.question: Did the sea surface temperatures in March 2022 at a location 100 km offshore east of Cairns, Australia, show temperature changes greater than 1°C compared to the overall average water temperatures from 2003 to 2014?

data.raw_code: 1. Search Strategy: - Use MODIS Aqua SST data (MODISA) for sea surface temperature - Location: 100 km offshore east of Cairns, Australia (-16.92°S, 145.78°E) - Time periods: - Baseline: 2003-2014 (full years) - Comparison: March 2022 - Collection: 'MODIS/Aqua/L3SMI' (Sea Surface Temperature) 2. Masking Strategy: - MODIS SST has quality flags - use 'quality' band to mask poor quality pixels - Mask land pixels using 'land' band 3. Logic: - Calculate baseline average SST (2003-2014) - Calculate March 2022 average SST - Compute difference and check if >1°C - Handle empty collections and valid pixel checks Potential issues: - MODIS data starts in 2002, so 2003-2014 should be fine - Need to handle quality masking - Need to check for valid pixels after masking ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const cairns = ee.Geometry.Point([145.78, -16.92]); const offshorePoint = cairns.transform('EPSG:4326', 100000); // Move 100km east const region = offshorePoint.buffer(10000); // 10km buffer for analysis // Time periods const baselineStart = '2003-01-01'; const baselineEnd = '2014-12-31'; const comparisonStart = '2022-03-01'; const comparisonEnd = '2022-03-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Aqua SST const sstCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/Aqua/L3SMI'); // Baseline collection (2003-2014) const baselineCol = sstCollection .filterDate(baselineStart, baselineEnd) .select('sst'); // March 2022 collection const march2022Col = sstCollection .filterDate(comparisonStart, comparisonEnd) .select('sst'); // Check collection sizes const baselineSize = baselineCol.size().getInfo(); const march2022Size = march2022Col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Baseline Images (2003-2014): ${baselineSize}`); console.log(`March 2022 Images: ${march2022Size}`); if (baselineSize === 0 || march2022Size === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Create composites and mask const baselineMean = baselineCol.mean().multiply(0.001); // Scale factor for SST const march2022Mean = march2022Col.mean().multiply(0.001); // Mask land pixels const landMask = sstCollection.first().select('land').eq(0); const baselineMasked = baselineMean.updateMask(landMask); const march2022Masked = march2022Mean.updateMask(landMask); // Check valid pixels const baselineCount = baselineMasked.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 4000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sst').getInfo(); const march2022Count = march2022Masked.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 4000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sst').getInfo(); console.log(`Baseline valid pixels: ${baselineCount}`); console.log(`March 2022 valid pixels: ${march2022Count}`); if (baselineCount === 0 || march2022Count === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean SST values const baselineSST = baselineMasked.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 4000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sst').getInfo(); const march2022SST = march2022Masked.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 4000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sst').getInfo(); console.log(`Baseline SST (2003-2014): ${baselineSST?.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`March 2022 SST: ${march2022SST?.toFixed(2)}°C`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (baselineSST === null || march2022SST === null || isNaN(baselineSST) || isNaN(march2022SST)) { console.log("C3"); return; } const difference = march2022SST - baselineSST; console.log(`Temperature difference: ${difference.toFixed(2)}°C`); if (Math.abs(difference) > 1.0) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
